pair.noGateway: No OpenEPaperLink AP address configured yet. Open the app settings and enter the IP address of your AP, then try again.
pair.unreachable: Could not reach the OpenEPaperLink AP at __gateway__: __error__. Check that the address in the app settings is correct and that the AP is powered on.
pair.badResponse: The AP at __gateway__ answered, but not with a tag list. Check that the address points at an OpenEPaperLink AP.
pair.apAlreadyAdded: The access point has already been added. This app talks to one access point at a time, so there is nothing more to add.
pair.apNotFound: No OpenEPaperLink access point found. Check that it is powered on and on the same network as Homey, or set its address in the app settings first.
